title: Muhurat Trading 2026: Date & Time for NSE and BSE
summary: Muhurat Trading 2026 starts at 2:20 PM on 8 November. Check NSE and BSE equity timings, F&O hours, pre-open, closing auction and Diwali market holidays.
body_markdown:
Muhurat Trading 2026 will take place on Sunday, 8 November, for Diwali Laxmi Pujan. Equity trading on NSE and BSE begins at 2:20 PM, following pre-open from 2:05 PM to 2:20 PM. Continuous trading ends at 3:15 PM for Closing Auction Session (CAS) securities and 3:30 PM for non-CAS securities. NSE futures and options trade until 3:40 PM.


The timings have been announced in the exchanges’ 19 October circulars. The afternoon schedule applies to this year’s session; do not use timings from an earlier Diwali.

The limit-only phases can close randomly within their final two minutes. Market orders cannot be changed or cancelled during those phases. IPOs, relisted shares and illiquid securities have separate arrangements.


Sources:[NSE equity circular NSE/CMTR/76941](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR76941.pdf) and[BSE equity notice 20261019-9](https://www.bseindia.com/markets/MarketInfo/DispNewNoticesCirculars.aspx?page=20261019-9) , both dated 19 October 2026.


## Why are there different closing times?


[CAS](https://algotest.in/blog/closing-auction-session/) is an auction used to determine the closing price of eligible securities. For these shares, continuous trading stops before the auction begins. Other shares continue trading until 3:30 PM.


Check which session applies to the security you want to trade. The 4:15 PM modification deadline is an administrative cutoff, not an extension of normal trading.


## Muhurat Trading 2026 F&O and MCX Timings


NSE futures and options trading runs from 2:20 PM to 3:40 PM on 8 November 2026. The trade modification window ends at 3:50 PM, according to[NSE F&O circular NSE/FAOP/76940](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP76940.pdf) .

Sources: BSE equity derivatives notice 20261019-10 and MCX circular MCX/TRD/590/2026, both dated 19 October 2026.


Do not apply the equity closing time to F&O. Check your broker’s notice for supported contracts, order types and intraday square-off deadlines, which may be earlier than the exchange close. Each exchange sets its own modification cutoff, so check the one that applies to your segment.

## What Is Muhurat Trading?


Muhurat trading is a special Diwali market session in which investors make trades to mark an auspicious beginning. The 2026 occasion is associated with Samvat 2083 in the stock-market tradition.


These are real transactions. A small ceremonial purchase still creates an investment exposure, and the exchange circulars confirm that executed trades create settlement obligations.


The occasion does not guarantee positive returns. The price you pay, the investment’s quality and your risk remain relevant.


Commodity traders should check the separate[MCX holiday schedule](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-holidays/) .


## How to Prepare for Muhurat Trading


**Check your account before the session.** Confirm available funds or margin, active trading segments and your broker’s special-session instructions.


**Decide what you want to buy or trade.** Set your budget and reason for entering before the market opens. Avoid choosing a stock solely because it appears on a festive stock-picks list.


**Check the bid-ask spread.** Liquidity can vary by security. A[limit order](https://algotest.in/blog/trading-orders-explained/) controls the price you accept, although it may remain unfilled.


**Set an exit plan for short-term trades.** Know your broker’s square-off time and the session applicable to your instrument. Our[trading risk-management guide](https://algotest.in/blog/trading-risk-management-rules-examples-and-a-practical-plan/) explains position sizing and loss limits.


**Review automated strategies before enabling them.** Check entry times, exits, broker availability and any platform instructions for the special session. A strategy configured for regular market hours needs a separate review.

### FAQs


#### What is the Muhurat Trading 2026 date?


Muhurat Trading 2026 is scheduled for Sunday, 8 November, on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.


#### Is Muhurat Trading 2026 in the afternoon or evening?


It is in the afternoon. Equity continuous trading begins at 2:20 PM IST. The detailed table above shows the pre-open, auction and closing phases.


#### Can I trade Nifty futures and options during Muhurat trading?


NSE has announced an F&O session from 2:20 PM to 3:40 PM. Confirm your broker’s participation, supported contracts and order restrictions before trading.


#### Is Muhurat trading free of brokerage and taxes?


Do not assume it is free. Any brokerage waiver depends on the broker’s offer, while applicable statutory charges and settlement obligations still need to be considered. Check the offer’s terms and your broker’s charge schedule.


#### Does the stock market always rise during Muhurat trading?


No. Festive sentiment does not determine returns. Stocks and derivatives can fall during the session, and an auspicious date is not a substitute for assessing risk.


#### Can I use the NSE schedule for MCX Muhurat trading?


No. MCX runs its own schedule: a special session from 2:05 PM to 2:19 PM, then trading from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM, as per MCX circular MCX/TRD/590/2026. Confirm your broker’s announcement before trading.
